feature: One way to open a recording: the editor, with Trim, Save, Export and Revert
summary: In Next every recording now opens in the editor and nowhere else: the small recording window and the switch that brought it back are gone. Trim works on a clip you have cut, catching on the cuts, and Video > Revert to Original puts the recording back as it opened.
setup: Photonz Next, no switch changed from its default. The Screen Recording grant was on and the screen unlocked, so every picture here is a real capture of the window.

try.do: Open any .mp4 from Finder or history. It opens in the editor with the timeline, never the small window.
Split the clip twice with Command K, then press C until Trim is in hand. The cuts stay drawn on the bar and the clip's name sits on it.
Drag the left handle toward the first cut and let go a few frames short of it. It lands on the cut. Hold Command to drag past without catching.
Bring the right handle onto the last cut. The capsule reads 0:04 kept.
Press Return. Exactly the middle piece is kept, four seconds, one piece.
Press Command S. It saves a project and leaves the recording file untouched, and the playhead stays where it was.
Choose Video > Revert to Original. The whole eight seconds come back; Command Z brings the trim back.

evaluate: Does a handle catching on a cut feel like Premiere's snap to an edit point, or does it grab too early or too late?
Is Video the right menu for Revert to Original, or would you look for it under File the way Photoshop has File > Revert?
With the small window gone, is there anything you used it for that you cannot now find in the editor?
Is it clear from the drawn bar which pieces a trim is about to drop?
rough: The small recording window's code is still in the app, because Current (the shipping release) still opens recordings in it and a Next change may not touch Current. Nothing in Next reaches it; it goes when Next is promoted.
Until today, putting a Trim handle on or past a cut and pressing Trim did nothing at all, silently. Fixed in this task, with tests.
The Trim button in the pictures looks grey like Cancel. It is the prominent style; it draws grey because the walk's window is never the key window. On your screen it is blue.
The two old-window guides (Trim a recording, Export MP4, GIF or HEIC) are gone. The editor's six video guides already cover cutting and exporting.
The old window's export sheet had a walk proving the file it weighed is the one Export hands over. The editor's video sheet does the same, but no walk proves it on the editor yet.
